subject.title: fix(secrets): degrade stale auth profile refs on startup

question: Should an unavailable explicit auth-profile SecretRef terminate all prepared authentication attempts, or disable only that profile and allow configured healthy fallback candidates?
rationale: This branch deliberately reverses an existing fallback behavior, and the repository policy treats fallback removal and fail-closed provider routing as compatibility-sensitive product choices.

options.title: Preserve profile fallback
options.body: Mark the failed profile unavailable, continue healthy credential and route candidates, and return the unavailable-owner error only when no viable candidate remains.

options.title: Approve terminal failure
options.body: Keep the new fail-closed semantics, but explicitly document and test the upgrade impact for users with backup auth profiles or fallback routes.

options.title: Narrow to startup only
options.body: Land only the startup snapshot isolation and defer request-time fallback policy to a separate focused change.

recommendation.title: Preserve profile fallback
recommendation.body: Mark the failed profile unavailable, continue healthy credential and route candidates, and return the unavailable-owner error only when no viable candidate remains.
